# Game Animation Training 4

**LEVEL 3 \- Creature Body Mechanics**

## **🦢 Wings**

### **🐧 Idle**

* Create an idle loop motion that shows the creature flapping its wings in mid-air on the same spot and is **ready for combat**  
* To show variance and so that it does not feel repetitive, please create a total of 3 loops  
* Each loop should have the same number of frames which is around 80-150 frames per loop  
* Please ensure that the first and last pose are the same  
* The duration of this motion is 2 MDs

  ### **🕊 Locomotion**

* Create a simple loop that shows a progressive movement of flying and that it should stem from your Idle pose (It should be in the same universe as your Idle motion)   
* To show variance and so that it does not feel repetitive, please create a total of 3 loops  
* Please ensure that your motion has an average speed based on the formula below:   
  			***3.4 x Total Length of character***

  		Take Dragon\_m01\_other rig as an example. 

  ![][image1]

    
  The total length of the character is about 19.5m, so the formula will be  
  			***3.4 x 19.5m \= 66.3m***  
  		So the moving speed with be 66.3m/s

  Please note that the speed here is for active flying / cruising speed.

    
  For other speeds that you need, you can refer to the table below.

| Mode | Formula | Example (19.51m Dragon) |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Glide | V \= 2 x Length | 2 × 19.51 ≈ **39.02 m/s** |
| Fly (Cruise) | V \= 3.4 x Length | 3.39 × 19.51 ≈ **66.2 m/s** |
| Dive (Sprint) | V \= 6 x Length | 4.5 × 19.51 ≈ **117.06 m/s** |

* Please ensure that the first and last pose are the same  
* The duration of this motion is 2 MDs

  ### **🦅 Attack**

* Please create an attack motion that looks believable  
* This motion should start and end from the Idle pose  
* For training purposes, please create a target for you to hit (It can be as simple as a cube)  
* Please ensure that your body mechanics look believable  
* Can use proxy effects  
* 2.5 MDs

## **🐎 Quadruped**

### **🐅 Idle**

* Create an idle loop motion that shows the creature **ready for combat**  
* To show variance and so that it does not feel repetitive, please create a total of 3 loops  
* Each loop should have the same number of frames which is around 60-80 frames per loop  
* Please ensure that the first and last pose are the same  
* The duration of this motion is 1.5 MDs

  ### **🦕 Locomotion**

#### 		**🐊 Walk  | 🐎 Trot | 🐅 Run** 

* **Please choose either a walk or run to work on**  
* Create a simple loop that shows a progressive movement and that it should stem from your Idle pose (It should be in the same universe as your Idle motion)   
* **The world control should be moving**   
* To show variance and so that it does not feel repetitive, please create a total of 3 loops  
* **❕❕❕ The speed of your creature really depends on the size of it in comparison with the in-house lsa\_Body\_Rig ❕❕❕**   
  * **The bigger the size, the faster the speed is going to be**   
    * **The bigger the size of the feet, the faster it will move**  
    * **Simple calculations for a walk cycle is feet length x2 or total character length x2 for characters without a feet**  
  * **The smaller the size, the slower the speed is going to be**  
  * **Below is a quick comparison of various size characters.**

    **![][image2]**

    

* Please ensure that your motion has an average speed of;  
  * **Walk \- around 60 cm/s (base on Gamma character)**  
  * **Trot \- around 200 cm/s**   
  * **Run \- around 450 cm/s (base on Gamma character)**  
* Please ensure that the first and last pose are the same  
* The duration of this motion is 2.5 MDs

  ### **🐉 Attack**

* Please create an attack motion that looks believable  
* This motion should start and end from the Idle pose  
* For training purposes, please create a target for you to hit (It can be as simple as a cube)  
* Please ensure that your body mechanics look believable  
* 2.5 MDs
